ui.inspect.summary: Read a bounded UIAutomation snapshot for the pinned Fusion process/document; no activation, focus change or UI action.

inputs.lease: Coordinator capability {id,requestId,operationId,expiresAt,target}; must bind this request, authorized operation and target; not a global lock manager.
inputs.target: {name,creationId?,fileId?,commandId?}; must match --doc and any identity pins. A missing creationId/fileId yields inspect-only partial/unverified state.
inputs.maxControls: Optional bounded UI control count, integer 1..512; truncation makes action unavailable.

limitations: Same-host Windows UIAutomation only through the addin backend. No automatic fallback; non-Windows/non-WSL host or missing process/window/document evidence returns unsupported/partial.

Search is bounded to the PID-pinned Fusion main window and owned/dialog descendants. Captions corroborate only; no focus, activation, viewport screenshot, desktop-wide search, model mutation or password value capture. activeCommand identity alone is not a modal inspection; a Fusion viewport screenshot is not a native-window image.

Returns actual Unicode Name, ControlType, AutomationId/runtime ID, ancestry, visibility/enabled and Invoke capability with one-use expiring observationId/controlRefs. An observation is not model acceptance. Source-derived AutomationIds are candidates, not guarantees: scope by container/ancestry, class, ControlType, Invoke and intent; titles/captions never identify the target alone.

Profile candidates without an exact native build/OS/locale qualification are reported but cannot be invoked. The observed Polish profile is not universal; unknown locales remain inspectable and block only when a required localized fallback is unavailable. Report actual matching method, qualification and operationOutcome:notEvaluated.

ui.respond.summary: Perform one authorized, freshly revalidated UIA action or qualified top-level native-command cancellation.

inputs.requestId: Same request ID and lease-bound operation as ui.inspect.
inputs.lease: Same live coordinator capability; rechecked immediately before the single action.
inputs.target: Exact target identity, matching --doc and creationId/fileId pins.
inputs.action: Intent-bound confirm|cancel|dismiss; contradictory action/intent is refused.
inputs.observationId: Fresh, unexpired inspection token; each accepted action attempt is single-use.
inputs.profileId: Required for profile mode; a qualified build/OS/locale profile only.
inputs.controlRef: Preferred opaque ref from this observation for observedControl mode.
inputs.containerRef: Required with exact-name selection; scopes to one observed dialog.
inputs.controlName: Exact observed Unicode Name; never translated or searched globally.
inputs.controlType: Must be Button for exact-name selection.
inputs.observedAutomationId: Optional exact value previously observed; never guessed.
inputs.expectedCommandId: Optional exact active command ID, checked before a native cancel.

limitations: Only one UIA InvokePattern or a qualified top-level UserInterface.terminateActiveCommand call. The dedicated cancellation route is not ordinary run and is not --readonly; ordinary run's active-command guard remains unchanged. Native termination is never issued from command event handlers or an atomic batch. Official API references: https://help.autodesk.com/view/NINVFUS/ENU/?guid=GUID-C0BE3D55-1C70-48B1-AE1A-8116518F12F9 and https://help.autodesk.com/view/NINVFUS/ENU/?guid=GUID-a8b3de5d-a667-444d-9518-f21bda0a9395.

Observed control text is not action semantics. Unknown/unqualified dialogs, stale process/window/document/lease/request/observation/control, duplicate controls, or role contradictions block with zero action. Exact-name selection is scoped to an observed dialog and returns ambiguous for duplicates; a caller-selected controlRef does not widen intent or authorization. Matching priority: native command ID, then structurally unique scoped AutomationId + ancestry/ControlType/available role/pattern/context, then exact qualified localized fallback. AutomationId is optional, sibling-scoped and not guaranteed stable between builds. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.windows.automation.automationelement.automationidproperty?view=windowsdesktop-10.0 and https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/ui-automation/use-the-automationid-property.

No raw keys, SendKeys, coordinates, mouse clicks, focus changes, discard, close-app, restart or retry. actionSubmitted, dialogClosed and operationOutcome:notEvaluated are separate; disappearance or a true API boolean is not CAD PASS. Unknown original operations are never replayed because a new script was rejected before mutation.

Source identifiers/localized strings are not universal profiles. Native cancellation matching is qualified only for Fusion 2705.1.25 / Windows 10.0.26200.0 / pl-PL: Move uses the runtime-discovered FusionMoveCommand and face Offset uses FusionOffsetFacesCommand. Generic sketch Offset (runtime ID Offset) observed CompletedTerminationReason (1) on the owned trial and is NOT qualified. CancelledTerminationReason (2), idle SelectCommand and unchanged BRep/pose/history were recorded for the advertised two profiles; no other builds, locales, command IDs or Derive cancellation are claimed.

ui.resolve.summary: Bounded inspect → one qualified authorized action → reinspect using ui.inspect/ui.respond primitives.

inputs.requestId: Stable identity; repeated calls return the recorded receipt and do not retry an unknown action.
inputs.lease: Same live coordinator capability, request, operation and target.
inputs.target: Exact document name plus optional creationId/fileId/commandId; native action requires a verified identity pin.
inputs.allowedProfiles: Optional subset of locally qualified profile IDs.
inputs.timeBudgetMs: Positive scheduling budget 1..120000 ms; it does not cancel an underlying Fusion operation.

limitations: Composition only; every step obtains a fresh observation and revalidates process start/window/document/request/lease/profile/control before action. Defaults to at most three actions and a bounded time budget; action exhaustion returns partial, not success.

Returns resolutionStatus resolved|nothingToDo|partial|blocked|unknown, action receipts and remainingUI. When automatic profile selection is unavailable it returns bounded candidates for ui.respond observedControl under the same authorization; it does not demand routine user clicks.

No retry of pending/unknown original operations, no action on unknown dialog/intent, no document activation/open, and no implication that UI resolution equals operation success; operationOutcome remains notEvaluated until the caller completes domain checks.

The private one-shot watcher is an internal prearmed host helper only. It has no SDK thread and can be stopped only by its owner; helper stop does not cancel Fusion. Watcher disarm/timeout is not proof that an underlying SDK operation was cancelled.
